name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: 'Pull Request number'
        required: true
        type: string
      repo:
        description: 'Repository name (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string
      gitref:
        description: 'Git reference (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.gitref }}
          repository: ${{ inputs.repo }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Validate PR number
        id: validate_pr
        run: |
          if ! [[ "${{ inputs.pr }}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::PR number must be a valid integer"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Fetch changed files
        id: fetch_files
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ inputs.pr }}
          CHANGED_FILES=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/files" -q '.[].filename' | tr '\n' ' ')
          echo "CHANGED_FILES=$CHANGED_FILES" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Post start comment
        id: post_start_comment
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.number }}
          body: "Starting AI documentation review for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}"

      - name: Run Devin Action
        id: run_devin_action
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@0d74d6d9ff1b16ada5966dc31af53a9d155759f4
        with:
          comment-id: ${{ steps.post_start_comment.outputs.comment_id }}
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_TOKEN }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          prompt-text: "Review the following files: $CHANGED_FILES"

      - name: Post skip comment
        id: post_skip_comment
        if: always()
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.number }}
          body: "AI documentation review skipped for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}"
